decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster system remains a close fit with the firm's core coolant-management portfolio and a large German machinery supplier would usually give such a recent, modular add-on more time to build sales and service demand.
The coolant cleaning centrifuge strengthens the firm's established filtration and process-media offering, so keeping it supports integrated customer solutions and recurring after-sales business.
The coolant nozzles line is a low-risk extension of the installed-base business that enables cross-selling and customization, making full withdrawal unlikely.
The scraper belt chip conveyor is somewhat less central than the firm's core media systems, but it still fits the broader material-flow and production-support portfolio well enough to retain.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor builds directly on the firm's chip-handling and automation capabilities and helps offer customers more complete system packages.

The hinged belt chip conveyor is an adjacent portfolio extension and, absent clear failure, a large established engineering firm would typically keep it on the market while assessing medium-term traction.
